meta.title: 4Hope — Play For Keeps
meta.description: We're a gaming crew built on good vibes, camaraderie, and a little luck. Meet the TFT and League roster, join player-run lobbies and follow live leaderboards.
meta.lobbiesDescription: Browse open and live lobbies, join a squad and follow the leaderboard in real time. Create your own lobby on 4Hope.

hero.subtitle: Good vibes, camaraderie, a little luck — that's 4Hope. TFT and League, always together.

contact.title: Talk to the squad
contact.lead: Pick what you need and your email app opens with the details ready to fill in.
